fallback.method: Heuristic regex scan over tracked and non-ignored untracked text files (source, docs, fixtures, CI and evidence); patterns for private-key PEM blocks, common cloud/API token forms, bearer credentials and high-confidence secret assignments; matched values never emitted.

limitations: Not equivalent to gitleaks/entropy and provider-specific detectors.
Ignored files and Git history were not scanned.
Scan is a snapshot; no claim that historical commits contain no secrets.
